pose: A single, colossal tree trunk of Metasequoia, standing vertically and perfectly straight. The top of the card shows where the trunk is cleanly 'sheared off,' providing a large, simplified flat launching platform.

environmental_details.ground: A flat plane of Coal Black and Dark Grey mud.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Warm, geometric patches of dappled light filtering from high above, creating strong tonal contrast on the simple trunk surface.
